why: Rank Bluminium's two candidate cells (z2-0, z2-1) after relaxing, which now also decides the 4D d¹ laser's gap and where d³'s spin-flip line sits (multiplets.mjs). pwrelax.mjs relaxes the ions in a fixed cell (plane-wave SCF, Hellmann–Feynman forces, BFGS, resumable each step) at scales 0.97, 1.00 and 1.03 for an E(V) fit. Both cells use the same 2×2×1×2 shifted k-grid, since their axes nearly match and a10 gave them 8 k against 4. The k-ladder groups ask how far the cells' difference still moves with sampling: unrelaxed single points at a14 (3×3×2×2, both cells) Γ-centred and shifted, because a10 against a10s moved the difference by 0.56 eV per formula. Expect relaxation to need two or three runs (warm-started steps of about 20–30 min).
